proposed.name: ev_note_locks
proposed.status: proposed, not provided by any core; modules cannot subscribe until it moves to events
proposed.when: the render takes a note event from its queue, after the voice is set up and before the event's parameter locks are applied, once per note event, for every source (sequencer, MIDI, arpeggiator); runs in the render on the main CPU
proposed.handler: void f(int track, void *event); the event's p-lock list pointer (event+0x38) may be replaced, by a list the handler keeps for as long as the voice lives; event+0 and the event's flags say where it came from
proposed.order: ascending order; every handler sees the pointer the one before left

sites.state: candidate read from the OS 1.44 image (main image SHA-256 fce648a9…168e4, the one core-dn1-2.0a-os1.44 targets) and its disassembly; run in digiemu on the sequencer path only; not run on a unit

open: What a MIDI note's event looks like here (its kind, flags and lock list pointer) is not observed: no MIDI note has been seen to reach the render queue in digiemu yet.
Whether a trigless trig reaches this site is not observed. If it does not, a second hook at the sequencer's producer of note events is needed, and is proposed on its own when known.
A MIDI note-on with no locks may skip the site: the stock code tests the list pointer after it. The hook sits before that test.
